name: Snipsy the Paper Goblin
description: Black panels with bitten edges and little cut-out creatures, as if done with stolen nail scissors.

designs.title: Folk Bird
designs.description: A plump bird cut out of a round black panel, with flowers and leaves around it.

designs.title: Tree of Life
designs.description: A branching tree full of flowers under a scalloped arch, two small birds at its roots.

designs.title: Marigold Skull
designs.description: A cut-paper skull with flowers for eyes, in a round panel with a ring of marigolds.

designs.title: Twin Deer
designs.description: Two spotted deer facing each other in a stamp-edged panel, antlers nearly touching.

designs.title: Sun and Moon
designs.description: A round panel split into day and night, with a smiling half-sun and a moon among stars.

designs.title: Paper Lantern
designs.description: A round black lantern with cut flowers and ribs, and a fringe of tassels underneath.
